statements: AB-13.17: "CLOUD EGRESS BOUNDARY — the only non-LAN hop in this domain"
AB-13.1: "Cloud egress boundary (the ONE external Nostr hop for mirror+control)"
AB-13.6: "a SECOND, independent JS consumer ... subscribes to the SAME relay"
reason: The change makes the management-api RelayConsumer open an extra NIP-42-authenticated connection to the public forum/cloud relay for kind 31403 governance decisions. That breaks the topic's claims that the cloud hop is the only non-LAN hop and that the JS consumer subscribes only to the same local relay. Many flake.nix and relay-consumer.js line anchors also shifted.
